description:
Google Meet API - Create instant meetings, schedule recurring standups, manage interview series, and create persistent meeting spaces. Includes SMART tools for common workflows.

⚠️ CRITICAL: ALL tools in this platform MUST be called through the execute_tool meta-tool for proper OAuth credential injection. DO NOT call these tools directly. Always use: execute_tool(tool_name='toolname', ...parameters)

tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:
(1) ALWAYS execute THIS tool NOW - NEVER reference 'I created earlier' or use conversation history
(2) MUST return format: **[Name]** | ID: `[id]` | URL: [full_url] | Link: [title](url)
(3) Use EXACT values from tool response - NEVER make up fake URLs/IDs
